title: The grant is reachable only through the general services index
statement: The subject’s grant page is reachable only through a general index while the benchmark council links its equivalent page from the relevant section navigation.
implication: A resident who does not already know the grant’s exact name is less likely to find it here than on the benchmark council’s site.
audience_relevance: Eligible residents who have not already been told the grant exists are the ones this affects.

title: Three required application fields have no accessible label
statement: Three required fields in the application form have no label a screen reader can announce.
implication: A resident using a screen reader cannot reliably tell what three of the required fields are asking for.
audience_relevance: Residents using assistive technology to complete the form are directly blocked by this.
